description: ONS publishes the simplified daily electricity-operation programme produced by DESSEM at half-hourly subsystem resolution. The dictionary lists demand, renewable generation, hydropower generation, thermal generation and pumping consumption in megawatts, with reference date and load block. These projected balances support dispatch and supply-demand studies. They are scheduled model results, not verified generation observations. The separately catalogued detailed DESSEM balance has a different level of detail. Coverage is electricity subsystems in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
